pc: 佳迅（惠州）智能科技有限公司，主要专注于SFP光模块、光纤笼子、RJ45网络接口、网络变压器\滤波器、网络交换机及PLC-IOT智慧工业照明整体解决方案，是一家集设计研发、生产制造、市场销售为一体的专业网络通信和光通信产品设计制造企业，成立于2020年, 公司先后在深圳，惠州，湖北等地成立生产基地,现有员工达1200余人,月产量达90KK只。拥有高效的生产设备以及从国外进口的精密专业网络分析测试仪器。雄厚的生产实力，强大的技术能力, 严格的品质管理操作，高素质的管理队伍，合理的价格，确保我们能于短时间内交货，并根据您的实际需求提供完善的磁性组件解决方案及强大的技术支持。

pr: Optical cage (SFP/QSFP Cage, optical module shielding cage) is a precision metal shielding component soldered to the PCB, used to hold pluggable optical modules and compliant with the MSA standard. It provides mechanical positioning and locking, EMI shielding, grounding and discharge, and thermal dissipation to preserve high-speed signal integrity, and supports hot-plugging. Specifications cover SFP, SFP+, SFP28, QSFP+, QSFP28 and QSFP-DD, with single-port, multi-port stacked, and light-guide-pipe versions available. Compatible with 1G to 800G optical modules, widely used in data center switches, AI servers, industrial control equipment, and optical transmission equipment.

光纤笼子（SFP/QSFP Cage，光模块屏蔽笼）是焊接于 PCB 的精密金属屏蔽组件，用于承载可插拔光模块，符合 MSA 标准。提供机械定位锁合、EMI 电磁屏蔽、接地泄放、导热散热，保障高速信号完整性，支持热插拔。规格覆盖 SFP、SFP+、SFP28、QSFP+、QSFP28、QSFP-DD，可选单口、多口堆叠、带导光柱版本，适配 1G~800G 光模块，广泛应用于数据中心交换机、AI 服务器、工控设备、光纤传输设备。

Optical module (optical transceiver module) is a core optical communication component that converts between electrical and optical signals. It supports hot-plugging and has built-in DDM digital diagnostics for real-time monitoring of parameters such as optical power and temperature. Covers SFP/SFP+/SFP28/QSFP+/QSFP28/QSFP-DD packages, with data rates of 1.25G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G, 400G and 800G. Single-mode and multi-mode options are available for different transmission distances. Compatible with mainstream switches and servers, widely used in data centers, compute clusters, security surveillance, industrial control, 5G base stations, and enterprise fiber networking, with stable transmission and strong interference resistance.

光模块（光纤收发模块）是光通信核心器件，实现电信号与光信号相互转换，支持热插拔，内置 DDM 数字诊断，实时监测光功率、温度等参数。覆盖 SFP/SFP+/SFP28/QSFP+/QSFP28/QSFP-DD 封装，速率含 1.25G、10G、25G、40G、100G、400G、800G；可选单模、多模，适配不同传输距离。兼容主流交换机、服务器，广泛用于数据中心、算力集群、安防、工控、5G 基站、企业光纤组网，传输稳定、抗干扰强。
传输速率 百兆 / 千兆 / 2.5G / 5G / 10G

The integrated RJ45 connector combines the network port, network transformer and LED indicators in one unit. Its compact structure eliminates the separate network filter placement step and saves PCB layout space. It supports 100M / 1G / 2.5G / 5G / 10G data transmission. Shielded versions offer strong interference resistance and suit industrial control, switches, security equipment, smart home and other applications. Stable performance and easy installation.
集成式 RJ45 连接器集成网口、网络变压器、LED 指示灯于一体，结构紧凑，省去单独贴装网络滤波器工序，节省 PCB 布局空间。支持百兆 / 千兆 / 2.5G / 5G / 10G 数据传输，屏蔽款抗干扰能力强，适配工业控制、交换机、安防设备、智能家居等场景，性能稳定，安装便捷。

A network transformer, also called an Ethernet isolation transformer or LAN transformer, is a core magnetic component in the Ethernet link. It sits between the PHY chip and the network port to provide signal coupling, high-voltage electrical isolation, impedance matching, and common-mode noise suppression, and it supports PoE power delivery. It isolates surge and lightning strikes, improves signal integrity, and extends transmission distance. Specifications cover 100M, 1G, 2.5G, 5G and 10G, in separate SMD types and integrated RJ45 types with built-in magnetics. Industrial wide-temperature grades and rated isolation voltage are available. Widely used in switches, industrial control boards, security cameras, IoT terminals, and medical communication equipment.

网络变压器，又称以太网隔离变压器、LAN Transformer，是以太网链路核心磁性元件，置于 PHY 芯片与网口之间，实现信号耦合、高压电气隔离、阻抗匹配、共模干扰抑制，支持 PoE 供电方案。可隔离浪涌、雷击冲击，改善信号完整性，延长传输距离。规格覆盖百兆、千兆、2.5G、5G、10G，分独立贴片式与集成 RJ45 内置款，工业级宽温，隔离耐压达标，广泛用于交换机、工控主板、安防摄像头、物联网终端、医疗通信设备。

A network switch is the core device of Ethernet networking. It handles packet switching and forwarding and offers mixed optical-electrical access with RJ45 electrical ports and SFP/QSFP optical ports. Covers 100M, 1G, 10G, 25G and 100G speeds, in unmanaged, Layer 2 managed, and Layer 3 switch types. Supports VLAN, LACP link aggregation, QoS, ring redundancy protection, PoE power delivery and other functions. Flexible port configuration, with rack-mount and DIN-rail industrial models available. Industrial models support wide-temperature operation and lightning and interference protection. Widely used in data centers, enterprise campuses, security surveillance, smart manufacturing, and intelligent transportation. Can be used together with optical modules and integrated RJ45 ports.

网络交换机是以太网组网核心设备，负责数据包交换转发，提供 RJ45 电口与 SFP/QSFP 光口光电混合接入。覆盖百兆、千兆、万兆、25G、100G 速率，分非网管、二层网管、三层交换机；支持 VLAN、LACP 链路聚合、QoS、环网保护、PoE 供电等功能。端口配置灵活，有机架式、导轨工业款可选，工业型号支持宽温、防雷抗干扰。广泛用于数据中心、企业园区、安防监控、智能制造、智慧交通，可搭配光模块、集成 RJ45 网口配套使用。

A PLC power line carrier module transmits data over existing power cables, so no separate communication wiring is needed. It uses OFDM modulation and comes in narrowband and HPLC broadband carrier options. It supports automatic networking and multi-hop relay forwarding, has built-in AES encryption, and resists power line noise. It supports interfaces such as UART/TTL and can be embedded directly into terminal devices. Suited to automatic meter reading, smart street lighting, PV monitoring, EV charging piles, building automation, smart home and other applications. Greatly reduces wiring and installation costs. The industrial wide-temperature version suits complex power distribution environments.
PLC 电力载波模组，依托现有电力线缆传输数据，无需额外布设通信线，采用 OFDM 调制技术，分为窄带、HPLC 宽带载波方案，支持自动组网、多级中继转发，自带 AES 加密，抗电力噪声干扰。支持 UART/TTL 等接口，可直接嵌入终端设备，适配电表集抄、智慧路灯、光伏监控、充电桩、楼宇自控、智能家居等场景，大幅降低布线施工成本，工业级宽温版本适配复杂配电环境。
